title: Worth Less than when Funko Managed it
text: The items in February's box are nice but not worth the cost of the box.  In the last movie moment box by Funko, Revenge of the Sith, we got the movie moment bobble, a pin, a badge, a luggage tag and a mini bobble.  February came with the movie moment, a mini, a sticky note pad and a sticker. Any one the pin, the badge or the luggage tag from the Revenge box are worth as much as the sticky notes AND the sticker.  Cost aside, both the sticky notes and the sticker are '1 time use' and are gone after that use. That is the exact OPPOSITE purpose of a collectables box!  The jedi sticker is also something that can be purchased separately which again is not the purpose of a collectables box.  I'm obviously going to get the Wookie box but that will be my last one.
label: negative
